fields.quoted_span:
The 2026 AGA may not adjust tenants’ rents when their tenancy began on or after
January 1, 2025, and who had their rents set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental
Housing Act.
fields.note: D008 supports the 2026 AGA of 1.0% (65% of the 1.5% CPI for July 2024 to June 2025), the Oct. 16, 2025 adoption, the no-earlier-than Jan. 1, 2026 timing, the Costa-Hawkins exclusion, the 2004 voter approval of the 65% formula, and Reg. 1148's qualifying conditions and notice. It does not support the Measure BB 5% cap, banked AGAs, the fully covered units limitation, capital improvement petitions, or the utilities rules. Those claims are not in D008.

At its regular meeting on October 16, 2025, the Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board 
adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026
fields.note: The 2026 AGA Order was adopted and applies from Jan. 1, 2026. The document does not state outright that it is in force, and says nothing about the Measure BB cap.

fields.quoted_span:
The 2026 AGA may not adjust tenants’ rents when their tenancy began on or after
January 1, 2025, and who had their rents set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental

fields.note: Only the Costa-Hawkins tenancy exclusion is in D008. The construction cutoff, single-family, condo, Golden Duplex and other exemptions come from other documents and are not in D008.

fields.quoted_span:

fields.note: D008 supports BMC § 13.76.110A, Rent Board Regulation 1148 and the AGA Order for 2026. The cited § 13.76.110 is the parent of that subsection. The other aliases (Measure BB, ch. 13.76 and others) are not in D008.
